title: Add ability to search for wallpapers
line: The wallpaper picker now has a search field that filters wallpapers by name or filename.
explanation: The Image wallpaper picker listed every installed and added wallpaper with no way to filter them, so finding one in a large collection meant scrolling. Open MR plasma-workspace!7407 (Peder Bergan) adds a Kirigami search field to the Images header (Ctrl+F) that filters the grid by display name or filename, with locale-aware case-insensitive matching, while keeping the configured wallpaper, keyboard navigation and Apply/Cancel behaviour intact.

commits.message:
wallpapers/image: Add wallpaper search

Large wallpaper collections had no way to find an image by name. Add a
search field to the Images header of the picker that filters by display
name or filename, keeping selection and keyboard navigation working.

BUG: 520221

media.caption: Master: the Images header has only Add and Get New, no way to search
With the MR: typing "cas" in the new search field shows only Cascade

review.text: MR !7407 works and the screenshots show filtering, but it is far heavier than the feature needs: about 1000 lines, including a new C++ ICU StringSearch class for matching names, a recursive walk of the header's children to find the overflow button, separate inline and popup field tracking, and a rewrite of the grid's current-index handling. KSortFilterProxyModel already offers filterString/filterRoleName with case-insensitive matching, and the index logic changes touch Apply/Cancel behaviour that is unrelated to search. Since this is Peder's MR, the useful step is review feedback on !7407 asking to slim it down, not a separate fix.
changes: Drop WallpaperSearch/ICU and filter with KSortFilterProxyModel's filterString (case-insensitive, on display name plus a filename role) or a short filterRowCallback using localeCompare/toLowerCase
Replace findSearchButton's child-tree walk and the inline/popup field bookkeeping with a plain Kirigami.SearchField in the header (or Kirigami's own action handling for Ctrl+F)
Keep the currentIndex/resetCurrentIndex rewrite to the minimum the filter needs, or split it into its own commit with its reason
